summary: The new run establishes substantially broader, inspectable research than the four-work baseline. It accounts for backward and forward branches through 2026-10-17 without a paper quota. Representative source checks support the distinctions below, but the independent all-microwave experiment remains abstract-only. Research acceptance in #12 remains open.

checks.observation: The foundations branch includes Shor, stabilizer formalism, topological memory and surface-code constructions; the separate repeated-correction branch traces experimental scaling. Seed v1 PDF sections I-II and bibliography pp. 8-10 support this separation. The map does not turn a finite-size memory improvement into a universal gate threshold proof.

The candidate ledger accounts for repeated detection, correction and scaling work, with explicit ion, bosonic, neutral-atom and lower-overhead alternatives. Their settings retain cycle, code and sample-selection differences. Inclusion is a scope judgment, not evidence that every relevant experiment was discovered.

checks.criterion: Decoder accuracy, throughput, latency and feedback
checks.observation: Seed v1 PDF section V supports sustained d=5 decoding with 63 microsecond average endpoint latency and explicitly excludes logical feedback. Result seed-realtime preserves that distinction. Relation rel-020 identifies Sparse Blossom use; rel-021 and rel-022 remain citation-only rather than claiming adoption of particular parallel implementations.

Seed v1 PDF sections III-IV support DQLR sensitivity and a repetition-code rare-event floor, not a measured 2D surface-code floor. Relations rel-013 and rel-018 retain this distinction. The all-microwave PRL full text remains unavailable; no matching arXiv or author copy was confirmed. Its abstract supports only a provisional parallel-development annotation, not a complete methods comparison.

checks.criterion: Forward coverage through the actual cutoff
checks.observation: The held-out dynamic-code and heavy-hex works are present with explicit versions and directional-scaling limits. Searches also inspect 2026 real-time decoders and logical operations, including an October preprint. This demonstrates forward expansion rather than stopping at the 2024 seed; it does not establish exhaustive recall.

The supplied 2408.13687v1 remains pinned. The later Nature author correction is a separate work and rel-024 targets the repetition-code axis/legend correction. Parent verification used the pinned seed PDF because generated HTML showed a misleading later date and shifted reference numbering. Journal access failures are not counted as parent full-text reads.

Checked 2607.01473v1 main Discussion and Appendix A against logical-cliffords-result and rel-053: a different d=3 logical-operation experiment, without post-selection, using the earlier processor/leakage protocols. Checked 2606.06598v1 section III against lattice-processor-result: leakage filtering precedes decoded Bell characterization; the detected-error-free subset is a further condition. Checked 2512.13908v1 sections II-III and 2409.17595v1 PDF section 2.6 against cultivation entries and rel-056: preparation post-selection, grafted-code idle degradation and the theory v1 sign issue remain explicit. These are passage spot checks, not verification of all 112 proposed annotations.

checks.criterion: Concise overview with the complete corpus retained
checks.observation: The SHA-bound HTML embeds the exact complete map: 52 works, 54 results and 58 relations. Five overview moments and nine route steps are presentation choices. The agent performed browser AX/DOM interactions; screenshot capture failed, so pixel-level visual acceptance is unavailable.
